section.content: 本发明涉及一种机器学习方法及机器学习系统，抑制服务器的处理负荷过剩地变高。在具备具有机器学习模型的车辆(2)和能够与车辆通信的服务器(3)的机器学习系统(1)中进行的对模型参数的值进行机器学习的机器学习方法包括以下步骤：服务器检测服务器的当前的处理负荷；服务器基于处理负荷来决定在服务器及车辆的各自中进行的机器学习的处理量；服务器根据决定的服务器中的机器学习的处理量来对模型参数的值进行机器学习；及车辆根据决定的车辆中的机器学习的处理量来对模型参数的值进行机器学习。服务器在处理负荷相对高时与相对低时相比减少服务器中的机器学习的处理量。

The invention relates to a machine learning method and a machine learning system, which can prevent the excessive increase of the processing load of a server. A machine learning method for machine learning a value of a model parameter, which is performed in a machine learning system (1) including a vehicle (2) having a machine learning model and a server (3) capable of communicating with the vehicle, includes the steps of: the server detects the current processing load of the server; the server determines a processing amount of machine learning to be performed in each of the server and the vehicle based on the processing load; the server machine-learns the values of the model parameters according to the determined machine-learning throughput of the server; and the vehicle machine-learns the value of the model parameter according to the determined amount of machine-learning processing in the vehicle. The server reduces the amount of processing of machine learning in the server when the processing load is relatively high as compared to when the processing load is relatively low.

Machine learning method and machine learning systemTechnical Field

The present disclosure relates to a machine learning method and a machine learning system.

Background

Conventionally, a system including a vehicle having a machine learning model for controlling a device mounted thereon and a server capable of communicating with the vehicle is known (for example, patent document 1). For example, in the system described in patent document 1, a server accumulates data acquired from a vehicle as a data set for learning, learns values of parameters of a machine learning model based on the accumulated data set, and notifies each vehicle of the learning results. Then, the vehicle performs image recognition processing using a machine learning model in which the learning result notified from the server is reflected.

In particular, in the system described in patent document 1, when data that is not easily recognized by a vehicle is transmitted from the vehicle to the server, the server updates the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model for the vehicle based on data acquired by another vehicle in a situation similar to the situation in which the data was acquired, in addition to the data.

Documents of the prior art

Patent document

Patent document 1: japanese patent laid-open publication No. 2019-021201

Disclosure of Invention

Problems to be solved by the invention

In the system described in patent document 1, the server learns the machine learning models of a plurality of vehicles communicating with the server. Thus, there are cases where machine learning of machine learning models of many vehicles must be performed simultaneously in the server. In such a case, the calculation load (hereinafter, also referred to as "processing load") of the machine learning processing in the server becomes high, and there is a possibility that the processing capability of the machine learning in the server is significantly reduced and the machine learning processing is stopped.

In view of the above problems, an object of the present disclosure is to suppress an excessive increase in the processing load of a server due to machine learning processing on a machine learning model of a vehicle.

Means for solving the problems

The gist of the present disclosure is as follows.

[1] A machine learning method for machine learning values of model parameters constituting a machine learning model in a machine learning system including a vehicle having the machine learning model for controlling a device mounted thereon and a server communicable with the vehicle, the machine learning method comprising:

the vehicle transmitting a delegation signal of machine learning that delegates values of the model parameters to the server;

the server detects the current processing load of the server;

the server determining, when the request signal is received from the vehicle, a processing amount or a processing ratio of the machine learning performed in each of the server and the vehicle based on the processing load;

the server machine-learns the values of the model parameters based on a training data set for machine-learning the values of the model parameters according to the decided processing amount or processing ratio of the machine learning in the server; and

the vehicle machine-learns the values of the model parameters based on the training data set according to the decided processing amount or processing ratio of the machine learning in the vehicle,

the server reduces a processing amount or a processing ratio of the machine learning in the server when the processing load is relatively high, as compared to when it is relatively low.

[2] The machine learning method according to [1] above, wherein the server determines to cause the vehicle to perform all of the processes of the machine learning when the processing load is higher than a predetermined reference processing load, and determines to cause the server to perform all of the processes of the machine learning when the processing load is equal to or lower than the reference processing load.

[3] The machine learning method according to [2] above, wherein the reference processing load is changed according to a type of the machine learning model.

[4] The machine learning method according to [3] above, wherein the reference processing load is higher in a case where the machine learning model is a model associated with safety of the vehicle than in a case where the machine learning model is a model not associated with safety of the vehicle.

[5] The machine learning method according to any one of the above [2] to [4], further comprising the steps of: calculating an expected learning time when the machine learning is performed based on the training data set in the vehicle and an expected communication time required for transmission and reception between the vehicle and the server for the training data set and the model parameters,

the reference processing load is a load of a time required for machine learning of the value of the model parameter in the server to subtract the expected communication time from the expected learning time or a load lower than the load.

[6] A machine learning system comprising a vehicle having a machine learning model for controlling a device mounted thereon and a server capable of communicating with the vehicle, for machine learning values of model parameters constituting the machine learning model,

the vehicle is provided with:

a learning request transmission unit that transmits a request signal for requesting machine learning of the value of the model parameter to the server; and

a vehicle-side learning unit that machine-learns the values of the model parameters based on a training data set for machine-learning the values of the model parameters,

the server is provided with:

a processing load detection unit that detects a current processing load of the server;

a processing amount determination unit configured to determine a processing amount or a processing ratio of the machine learning performed in each of the server and the vehicle based on the processing load when the request signal is received from the vehicle; and

a server-side learning unit that machine-learns the values of the model parameters based on the training data set,

the server-side learning unit and the vehicle-side learning unit each include a learning unit that performs machine learning on the values of the model parameters based on the determined processing amount or processing ratio of the machine learning,

the processing amount determination unit reduces the processing amount or the processing ratio of the machine learning in the server-side learning unit when the processing load is relatively high, as compared with when the processing load is relatively low.

Effects of the invention

According to the present disclosure, it is possible to suppress an excessive increase in the processing load of the server accompanying the machine learning process related to the machine learning model of the vehicle.

Detailed Description

Hereinafter, embodiments will be described in detail with reference to the drawings. In the following description, the same components are denoted by the same reference numerals.

< first embodiment >

Structure of machine learning System

First, a machine learning system 1 according to a first embodiment and a machine learning method performed in the machine learning system 1 will be described with reference to fig. 1 to 5. Fig. 1 is a schematic configuration diagram of a machine learning system 1 according to a first embodiment. The machine learning system 1 machine-learns a machine learning model unique to each vehicle using a training data set including values of a plurality of state parameters representing the state of each vehicle. The machine learning model is used to control a device mounted on a vehicle.

As shown in fig. 1, the machine learning system 1 includes a plurality of communicable vehicles 2 and a server 3. Each of the plurality of vehicles 2 and the server 3 are configured to be able to communicate with each other via a communication network 4 formed of an optical communication line or the like and a wireless base station 5 connected to the communication network 4 via a gateway (not shown). The communication between the vehicle 2 and the wireless base station 5 is communication in accordance with an arbitrary communication standard.

Fig. 2 is a diagram schematically showing the hardware configuration of the vehicle 2. As shown in fig. 2, the vehicle 2 includes an Electronic Control Unit (ECU) 11. The ECU11 has an in-vehicle communication interface 12, a storage device 13, and a processor 14. The in-vehicle communication interface 12 and the storage device 13 are connected to the processor 14 via signal lines. In the present embodiment, the vehicle 2 is provided with one ECU11, but a plurality of ECUs divided for each function may be provided.

The in-vehicle communication interface 12 has an interface circuit for connecting the ECU11 to an in-vehicle Network 15 conforming to the CAN (Controller Area Network) or other standard. The ECU11 communicates with other in-vehicle devices via the in-vehicle communication interface 12.

The storage device 13 is an example of a storage unit that stores data. The storage device 13 includes, for example, a volatile semiconductor memory (e.g., RAM), a nonvolatile semiconductor memory (e.g., ROM), a Hard Disk Drive (HDD), a Solid State Drive (SSD), or an optical recording medium. The storage device 13 stores a computer program for executing various processes in the processor 14, various data used when the various processes are executed by the processor 14, and the like. Therefore, the storage device 13 stores machine learning models unique to each vehicle.

The processor 14 has one or more CPUs (Central Processing units) and peripheral circuits thereof. The processor 14 may further include an arithmetic circuit such as a GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) or a logical operation Unit or a numerical operation Unit. The processor 14 executes various kinds of arithmetic processing based on computer programs stored in the storage device 13 of the ECU 11. Therefore, when the value of the input parameter of the machine learning model is input, the processor 14 performs arithmetic processing in accordance with the machine learning model and outputs the value of the output parameter.

Fig. 3 is a functional block diagram of the processor 14 of the vehicle 2. As shown in fig. 3, the processor 14 includes a control unit 141 that controls the control device 22 of the vehicle 2 using the machine learning model, a learning condition satisfaction/non-satisfaction determination unit 142 that determines whether or not a learning execution condition of the machine learning model is satisfied, a data set generation unit 143 that generates a data set for learning, a learning request transmission unit 144 that transmits a request for machine learning to the server 3, a vehicle-side learning unit 145 that performs machine learning on values of model parameters constituting the machine learning model, a model update unit 146 that updates the machine learning model used in the control unit 141, a vehicle-side transmission unit 147 that transmits various data to the server 3, and a vehicle-side reception unit 148 that receives various data from the server 3. These functional blocks of the processor 14 are, for example, functional modules realized by a computer program operating on the processor 14. Alternatively, these functional blocks included in the processor 14 may be dedicated arithmetic circuits provided in the processor 14. Details of each functional block of the processor 14 of the vehicle 2 will be described later.

As shown in fig. 2, the vehicle 2 further includes a vehicle exterior communication module 21, a plurality of control devices 22, and a plurality of sensors 23. The vehicle exterior communication module 21, the control device 22, and the sensor 23 are connected to the ECU11 via the vehicle interior network 15.

The vehicle exterior communication module 21 is an example of a communication unit that communicates with a device outside the vehicle. The vehicle exterior communication module 21 is a device for communicating with the server 3, for example. The off-board communication module 21 includes, for example, a Data Communication Module (DCM). The data communication module communicates with the server 3 via the wireless base station 5 and the communication network 4.

The control device 22 is a device that performs various controls related to the vehicle 2. Specifically, the control device 22 includes, for example, a drive actuator of a throttle valve that adjusts an opening degree of a throttle valve provided in an intake passage of the internal combustion engine, an injector that supplies fuel to a combustion chamber of the internal combustion engine, an ignition plug that ignites the fuel in the combustion chamber, a drive actuator of an EGR valve that controls an EGR rate of the internal combustion engine, a blower of an air conditioning apparatus, a drive actuator of an air mixing valve that controls a flow of air of the air conditioning apparatus, and the like. These control devices 22 are connected to the ECU11 via the in-vehicle network 15, and operate in response to drive signals from the ECU 11.

The sensor 23 is an example of a detector that detects values (state quantities) of various state parameters related to the vehicle 2. The sensor 23 includes, for example, an air amount sensor that detects an amount of intake air supplied to the internal combustion engine, an injection pressure sensor that detects a fuel injection pressure from an injector of the internal combustion engine, an exhaust gas temperature sensor that detects a temperature of exhaust gas, an input detection sensor that detects an input of a driver in a touch panel or the like, a self-position sensor (for example, GPS) that detects a self-position of the vehicle 2, and the like. The sensor 23 includes, for example, an outside air temperature sensor that detects the temperature of the air around the vehicle 2 (outside air temperature), an outside air humidity sensor that detects the humidity of the air around the vehicle 2 (outside air humidity), an atmospheric pressure sensor that detects the atmospheric pressure around the vehicle 2, an inside temperature sensor that detects the temperature in the room of the vehicle 2 (inside temperature), an inside humidity sensor that detects the humidity in the room of the vehicle 2 (inside humidity), and a solar radiation sensor that detects the amount of solar radiation. These sensors 23 are connected to the ECU11 via the in-vehicle network 15, and send output signals to the ECU 11.

The server 3 is provided outside the vehicle 2, and communicates with the running vehicle 2 via the communication network 4 and the wireless base station 5. The server 3 receives various information from the running vehicle 2.

Fig. 4 is a diagram schematically showing the hardware configuration of the server 3. As shown in fig. 4, the server 3 includes an external communication module 31, a storage device 32, and a processor 33. The server 3 may have an input device such as a keyboard and a mouse, and an output device such as a display.

The external communication module 31 is an example of a communication unit that communicates with a device outside the server 3. The external communication module 31 includes an interface circuit for connecting the server 3 to the communication network 4. The external communication module 31 is configured to be able to communicate with each of the plurality of vehicles 2 via the communication network 4 and the wireless base station 5.

The storage device 32 is an example of a storage unit that stores data. The storage device 32 of the server 3 also includes a volatile semiconductor memory (e.g., RAM), a nonvolatile semiconductor memory (e.g., ROM), a Hard Disk Drive (HDD), a Solid State Drive (SSD), or an optical recording medium. The storage device 32 stores a computer program for executing various processes by the processor 33, and various data used when the various processes are executed by the processor 33.

The processor 33 has one or more CPUs and peripheral circuits thereof. The processor 33 may further include an arithmetic circuit such as a GPU, a logical operation unit, or a numerical operation unit. The processor 33 executes various arithmetic processes based on a computer program stored in the storage device 32 of the server 3. In the present embodiment, the processor 33 of the server 3 functions as a machine learning device that performs machine learning of a machine learning model.

Fig. 5 is a functional block diagram of the processor 33 of the server 3. As shown in fig. 5, the processor 33 includes a processing load detection unit 331 that detects the current processing load of the server 3, a processing amount determination unit 332 that determines the processing amount of machine learning performed in each of the server 3 and the vehicle 2, a server-side learning unit 333 that performs machine learning on the values of model parameters constituting the machine learning model, a server-side transmission unit 334 that transmits various data to the vehicle 2, and a server-side reception unit 335 that receives various data from the vehicle 2. These functional blocks of the processor 33 are, for example, functional modules realized by a computer program operating on the processor 33. Alternatively, these functional blocks included in the processor 33 may be dedicated arithmetic circuits provided in the processor 33. Details of each functional block of the processor 33 of the server 3 will be described later.

Machine learning model

In the present embodiment, the machine learning model after machine learning is used when the control unit 141 of the vehicle 2 controls the control device 22 mounted on the vehicle 2. In the present embodiment, a neural network model (hereinafter, referred to as an "NN model") is used as the machine learning model. The outline of the NN model will be described below with reference to fig. 6. Fig. 6 shows an example of an NN model having a simple structure.

The circle symbols in fig. 6 represent artificial neurons. Artificial neurons are generally referred to as nodes or units (referred to as "nodes" in this specification). In fig. 6, L ═ 1 denotes an input layer, L ═ 2 and L ═ 3 denote hidden layers (or intermediate layers), and L ═ 4 denotes an output layer. In the present embodiment, the number of nodes of the hidden layer (L ═ 2 and L ═ 3) is smaller than the number of nodes of the input layer (L ═ 1), and the number of nodes of the hidden layer at the lower level is smaller than the number of nodes of the hidden layer at the upper level (for example, the number of nodes of the hidden layer (L ═ 3) is smaller than the number of nodes of the hidden layer (L ═ 2)).

As described above, the NN model includes an input layer, a hidden layer, and an output layer, and when values of a plurality of input parameters are input from the input layer, the values of one or more output parameters corresponding to the input parameters are output from the output layer.

In the present embodiment, as such a machine learning model, for example, a model is used which outputs the temperature of the exhaust gas as the value of the output parameter when the outside air temperature, the intake air amount, the fuel injection timing, the fuel injection pressure, and the EGR rate are input as the values of the input parameters. The control unit 141 of the vehicle 2 inputs the value of the state parameter detected by the sensor 23 and the control command value from the ECU11 to the control device 22 as the values of the input parameters to the machine learning model, and outputs the temperature of the exhaust gas as the output parameter. The control portion 141 controls the control device 22 related to the internal combustion engine (for example, a drive actuator of a throttle valve, an injector, an ignition plug, etc.) based on the output temperature of the exhaust gas. Here, since there is a response delay in the exhaust gas temperature sensor that detects the temperature of the exhaust gas, if the internal combustion engine is controlled based on the output of the exhaust gas temperature sensor, the internal combustion engine may not be appropriately controlled. In contrast, since no delay occurs in the calculation of the temperature of the exhaust gas using the machine learning model, the internal combustion engine can be controlled more appropriately by controlling the control device 22 relating to the internal combustion engine using the temperature of the exhaust gas calculated by the machine learning model.

Alternatively, as such a machine learning model, for example, a model may be used which outputs a target temperature of the air conditioner as a value of an output parameter when an outside air temperature, an outside air humidity, an inside temperature, an inside humidity, and a solar radiation amount are input as values of input parameters. In this case, the control unit 141 of the vehicle 2 inputs the value of the state parameter detected by the sensor 23 and the control command value from the ECU11 to the control device 22 as the value of the input parameter to the machine learning model, and outputs the target temperature of the air conditioner as the output parameter. The ECU11 controls the control device 22 related to the air conditioner (for example, a blower of the air conditioner, a drive actuator of an air mix door, and the like) so that the vehicle interior temperature becomes the target temperature output from the machine learning model.

As the machine learning model, various models can be used. Therefore, as the input parameters, various state parameters indicating the state of the vehicle, such as outside air temperature, outside air humidity, atmospheric pressure, vehicle interior temperature, vehicle interior humidity, solar radiation amount, intake air temperature, fuel injection pressure, fuel injection timing, fuel injection amount, air-fuel ratio, ignition timing, engine cooling water temperature, and supercharging pressure, are used. In addition, as the output parameters, various state parameters indicating the state of the vehicle, such as the temperature of the exhaust purification catalyst, the concentration of NOx in the exhaust gas, the output torque of the internal combustion engine, and the humidity in the vehicle interior, are used.

Machine learning of machine learning model

Next, machine learning of the machine learning model (NN model) as described above will be described. In order to improve the accuracy of the machine learning model, machine learning of values of model parameters constituting the machine learning model (hereinafter, also simply referred to as "machine learning of the machine learning model") needs to be performed. In the present embodiment, the vehicle-side learning unit 145 of the vehicle 2 or the server-side learning unit 333 of the server 3 performs machine learning of the machine learning model. Specifically, in the machine learning by the vehicle-side learning unit 145 or the server-side learning unit 333, the values of all the model parameters (the weight w, the offset b, and the like in the case of the NN model) of the machine learning model are calculated so that when the value of the input parameter is input to the machine learning model, the value of the appropriate output parameter corresponding to the value of the input parameter is output from the machine learning model. A method of learning the machine learning model by the vehicle-side learning unit 145 or the server-side learning unit 333 will be briefly described below.

In machine learning of the machine learning model, a training data set comprising measured values of the state parameters is used. The training data set is composed of a combination of a plurality of measured values of a plurality of input parameters and a plurality of measured values (positive solution data) of at least one output parameter corresponding to the measured values. In the present embodiment, the actual measurement values of the input parameters and the actual measurement values of the output parameters are values detected by the sensors 23 of the vehicle 2 or control command values from the ECU11 to the control device 2. In the present embodiment, when the server 3 performs machine learning of the machine learning model, the vehicle 2 transmits a training data set to the server 3. The training data set may be a data set obtained by preprocessing (normalization, or the like) the actual measurement values of the input parameters and the actual measurement values of the output parameters.

The vehicle-side learning unit 145 or the server-side learning unit 333 performs machine learning of the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model using the training data set. In the machine learning of the machine learning model, the vehicle-side learning unit 145 or the server-side learning unit 333 repeatedly updates the values of the model parameters (the weight w and the offset b) in the machine learning model by a known error back propagation method so that, for example, the difference between the output value of the machine learning model and the actually measured value of the output parameter included in the training data set becomes small. As a result, the machine learning model is learned, and a learned machine learning model is generated. The values of the model parameters (weight w, bias b, etc.) constituting the learned machine learning model are stored in the storage device 13 of the vehicle 2 or the storage device 32 of the server 3.

Learning processing of machine learning model

Next, a flow of a learning process of the machine learning model in the vehicle 2 or the server 3 will be described with reference to fig. 7 and 8. In the present embodiment, the subject of machine learning of the machine learning model is changed according to the processing load in the server 3. In particular, in the present embodiment, when the processing load on the server 3 is high, the vehicle 2 performs machine learning, and when the processing load on the server 3 is low, the server 3 performs machine learning. Therefore, in the present embodiment, there are a case where the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed by the vehicle 2 and a case where the machine learning is performed by the server 3. Therefore, the flow of the learning process in the case where the machine learning is performed by each of the vehicle 2 and the server 3 will be described below.

Fig. 7 is an operation sequence diagram of a learning process in a case where the server 3 performs machine learning of the machine learning model. Therefore, fig. 7 shows the flow of the learning process in the case where the processing load in the server 3 is low.

The learning condition satisfaction/non-satisfaction determination unit 142 of the vehicle 2 periodically determines whether or not the learning execution condition of the machine learning model of the vehicle 2 is satisfied (step S11). The machine learning of the machine learning model is performed, for example, at regular intervals, at regular travel distances, or at regular travel times. Therefore, when a predetermined period of time has elapsed since the previous machine learning, for example, the learning condition satisfaction/non-satisfaction determination unit 142 determines that the learning execution condition of the machine learning is satisfied. Here, the value of the optimal model parameter of the machine learning model changes due to the deterioration of the control device 22 over time, the change in the user's interest, and the like. By periodically performing machine learning of the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model in this manner, the values of the model parameters can be maintained at appropriate values.

The machine learning of the machine learning model may be performed at a timing different from the above-described timing. Therefore, the machine learning of the machine learning model may be performed, for example, when some abnormality occurs in the control device 22 of the command value used as the input parameter of the machine learning model or the sensor 23 that detects the value of the input parameter of the machine learning model. Therefore, in this case, the learning condition satisfaction/non-satisfaction determination unit 142 determines that the learning execution condition of the machine learning is satisfied when an abnormality occurs in the control device 22 or the sensor 23. Specifically, for example, when it is determined by an On-board diagnostics (On-board diagnostics) that an abnormality has occurred in the control device 22 or the sensor 23, and that a predicted value output by the machine learning model and an actual measurement value detected by the sensor 23 later differ by a reference value or more, the learning execution condition for machine learning is satisfied.

When the learning execution condition is satisfied, the data set generator 143 of the vehicle 2 creates a training data set (step S12). The data set generating unit 143 generates a training data set based on a detection value detected by the sensor 23 of the vehicle 2 during an arbitrary period and a control command value transmitted from the ECU11 to the control device 22 during the period. The data set generating unit 143 generates a training data set based on the detection value and the control command value acquired when the learning execution condition of the machine learning is satisfied. Alternatively, the data set generating unit 143 may store the detection values and the control command values in the storage device 13 from before the learning execution condition of the machine learning is satisfied, and generate the training data set based on the detection values and the control command values stored after the learning execution condition of the machine learning is satisfied. The data set generating unit 143 may generate a training data set by preprocessing (normalization, or the like) the detection values and the control command values. The generated training data set is stored to the storage device 13 of the ECU 11.

When the training data set is generated, the learning request transmitter 144 of the vehicle 2 transmits a request signal requesting machine learning of the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model to the server 3 via the vehicle-exterior communication module 21 (step S13). At this time, the learning request transmitter 144 may transmit information necessary for calculating the processing load in the server 3 associated with machine learning together with the request signal. Specifically, the learning request transmitting unit 144 transmits, for example, the size of the training data set created by the data set generating unit 143, the structure of the machine learning model (the number of layers, the number of nodes in each layer, and the like), and the type of the machine learning model (for example, a model contributing to the safety of the vehicle 2, a model contributing to the environment, and the like). However, when information such as the structure of the machine learning model corresponding to the vehicle 2 is stored in the storage device 32 of the server 3 in advance, the learning request transmission unit 144 does not transmit the information.

On the other hand, the processing load detection unit 331 of the server 3 detects the current processing load of the server 3 at all times or periodically (step S14). The processing load of the server 3 is a load related to the arithmetic processing of the server 3, and varies depending on, for example, the usage rate of the processor 33 of the server 3 (usage rate of CPU and GPU) and the free capacity of the semiconductor memory of the storage device 32 of the server 3. The larger the usage of the processor 33, the higher the processing load of the server 3 is detected, and the smaller the free capacity in the semiconductor memory, the higher the processing load of the server 3 is detected.

The processing load of the server 3 varies depending on the amount of arithmetic processing being performed in the server 3. Therefore, when the server 3 is performing learning of machine learning models of many other vehicles, or when various arithmetic processing other than learning is performed, the processing load of the server 3 is detected to be high. On the other hand, if the server 3 does not perform calculation processing other than learning or learning of the machine learning model of another vehicle, the processing load of the server 3 is detected to be low.

The processing load detection unit 331 may detect not only the current processing load of the server 3 but also a future processing load of the server 3. The future processing load is detected based on, for example, a task for which processing in the processor 33 of the server 3 is scheduled. The processing load detection unit 331 may be configured not to detect the processing load constantly or periodically but to detect the load processing when the server-side reception unit 335 receives the request signal via the external communication module 31.

When the server-side receiving unit 335 receives the request signal via the external communication module 31, the throughput determination unit 332 determines the subject of machine learning on the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model in the server 3 and the vehicle 2 based on the current processing load of the server 3 detected by the processing load detection unit 331 (step S15). In particular, in the present embodiment, the throughput determination unit 332 determines whether or not the current processing load of the server 3 is higher than a predetermined reference processing load. When determining that the current processing load of the server 3 is higher than the predetermined reference processing load, the processing amount determination unit 332 determines to cause all of the processing in the machine learning of the machine learning model to be performed in the processor 14 of the vehicle 2, that is, to cause the processing amount of the machine learning in the processor 33 of the server 3 to be zero. On the other hand, when determining that the current processing load of the server 3 is equal to or less than the reference processing load, the processing amount determination unit 332 determines to cause all the processing in the machine learning of the machine learning model to be performed in the processor 33 of the server 3, that is, to cause the processing amount of the machine learning in the processor 14 of the vehicle 2 to be zero. In the present embodiment, the reference processing load is a predetermined constant value (for example, 80% when the maximum value of the processing load of the server 3 is 100%).

The reference processing load may be a variable value instead of a predetermined constant value. For example, the reference processing load may be changed based on the type of the machine learning model transmitted to the server 3 by the learning request transmitting unit 144. Specifically, the reference processing load is changed from high to low in the order of the case where the machine learning model is a model associated with the safety of the vehicle 2, the case where the machine learning model is a model associated with the environmental load caused by the vehicle 2, and the case where the machine learning model is a model associated with the comfort of the occupants in the vehicle 2. Therefore, the reference processing load is set higher in the case where the machine learning model is a model associated with the safety of the vehicle 2 than in the case where the machine learning model is a model not associated with the safety of the vehicle 2.

As the model relating to the safety of the vehicle 2, for example, a model for detecting a failure of a control device 22 (for example, an internal combustion engine, a motor, a brake device, a steering device, and the like) related to the driving of the vehicle mounted on the vehicle 2, and a sensor 23 (for example, an exterior camera, a driver monitor camera, a radar, and the like) related to the safety may be considered. Specifically, as this model, for example, a model may be considered in which values of state parameters detected by various sensors 23 and control command values from the ECU11 to the control device 22 are input parameters, and the presence or absence of a failure of each device is output parameters. As a model related to the environmental load caused by the vehicle 2, for example, the above-described model for estimating the temperature of the exhaust gas can be considered. In addition, as a model relating to the comfort of the occupant in the vehicle 2, for example, the above-described model estimating the target temperature of the air conditioner may be considered.

Here, the reference processing load indicates a priority of machine learning in the server 3. When the reference processing load is low, it is not easy to perform machine learning in the server 3, and thus machine learning in the vehicle 2, which takes a long time for machine learning, is easy to perform. Therefore, a low reference processing load means that the priority for performing machine learning in the server 3 is low, and conversely, a high reference processing load means that the priority for performing machine learning in the server 3 is high. Therefore, by changing the reference processing load according to the type of the machine learning model as described above, the priority of machine learning in the server 3 of the model related to the safety of the vehicle 2 can be increased, and the priority of machine learning in the server 3 of the model related to the comfort of the occupant can be decreased.

When the processing amount determination unit 332 determines that the machine learning of the machine learning model is to be performed in the server 3, the server-side transmission unit 334 transmits a notification to the effect that the machine learning is performed in the server 3 to the vehicle 2 via the external communication module 31 (step S16).

When the vehicle-side receiving unit 148 receives the notification of the fact that the machine learning is performed in the server 3, the vehicle-side transmitting unit 147 transmits information necessary for performing the machine learning of the machine learning model of the vehicle 2 via the vehicle exterior communication module 21 (step S17). The information necessary for machine learning includes, for example, the training data set generated by the data set generating unit 143 and the current values of the model parameters of the machine learning model.

When the server-side receiving unit 335 receives information necessary for machine learning via the external communication module 31, the server-side learning unit 333 machine-learns the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model (step S18). The server-side learning unit 333 updates the values of the model parameters by a known method such as the error back propagation method described above using the training data set with the current values of the model parameters transmitted from the vehicle 2 as initial values. As a result, the server-side learning unit 333 generates a learned machine learning model (more specifically, a relearn machine learning model based on a new training data set). The values of the model parameters (weight w and bias b) constituting the learned machine learning model are stored in the storage device 32 of the server 3.

When the machine learning of the machine learning model by the server-side learning unit 333 is completed, the server-side transmitting unit 334 transmits the value of the model parameter obtained by the machine learning by the server-side learning unit 333 to the vehicle 2 via the external communication module 31 (step S19).

When the vehicle-side receiving unit 148 of the vehicle 2 receives the values of the model parameters from the server 3 via the vehicle-exterior communication module 21, the model updating unit 146 of the vehicle 2 updates the values of the model parameters constituting the machine learning model used in the control unit 141 to the values received from the server 3 (step S20). After that, the control unit 141 controls the control device 22 based on the machine learning model using the updated values of the model parameters.

As described above, it is understood that: in the example shown in fig. 7 of the present embodiment, it is determined that the current processing load of the server 3 is equal to or less than the reference processing load, and in this case, the processing amount of machine learning in the vehicle 2 is determined to be zero, and the processing amount of machine learning in the server 3 is determined to be the total processing amount of machine learning based on the training data set. In other words, it can be seen that: in this case, the processing ratio of the machine learning in the vehicle 2 and the machine learning in the server 3 is determined to be 0: 1.

fig. 8 is an operation sequence diagram of a learning process in a case where the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed by the vehicle 2. Therefore, fig. 8 shows the flow of the learning process in the case where the processing load in the server 3 is high.

As is apparent from fig. 8, even when the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed by the vehicle 2, the same processing as that performed when the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed by the vehicle 2 is performed until the subject of the machine learning model is determined (steps S11 to S14).

In the example shown in fig. 8, the processing amount determination unit 332 also determines the subject of the machine learning model in the server 3 and the vehicle 2 based on the current processing load of the server 3 (step S15). When the throughput determination unit 332 determines in step S15 that the machine learning of the machine learning model is to be performed in the vehicle 2, the server-side transmission unit 334 transmits a notification to the effect that the machine learning is performed in the server 3 to the vehicle 2 via the external communication module 31 (step S21).

When the vehicle-side receiving unit 148 receives the notification that the machine learning is to be performed in the vehicle 2, the vehicle-side learning unit 145 performs the machine learning on the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model without transmitting the training data set and the current values of the model parameters to the server 3 (step S22). The machine learning in the vehicle-side learning unit 145 is performed in the same manner as the machine learning in the server-side learning unit 333, and the vehicle-side learning unit 145 generates a learned machine learning model. The values of the model parameters constituting the learned machine learning model are stored in the storage device 32 of the vehicle 2.

When the machine learning of the machine learning model by the vehicle-side learning unit 145 is completed, the model updating unit 146 of the vehicle 2 updates the values of the model parameters constituting the machine learning model used in the control unit 141 to the values obtained by the learning by the vehicle-side learning unit 145 (step S23). After that, the control unit 141 controls the control device 22 based on the machine learning model using the updated values of the model parameters.

As described above, it is understood that: in the example shown in fig. 8 of the present embodiment, it is determined that the current processing load of the server 3 is higher than the reference processing load, and in this case, the processing amount of machine learning in the server 3 is determined to be zero, and the processing amount of machine learning in the vehicle 2 is determined to be the total processing amount of machine learning based on the training data set. In other words, it can be seen that: in this case, the processing ratio of the machine learning in the vehicle 2 and the machine learning in the server 3 is determined to be 1: 0.

effect

According to the machine learning system 1 and the machine learning method executed in the machine learning system 1 of the above-described embodiment, the machine learning of the machine learning model of the vehicle 2 is performed in the server 3 when the processing load in the server 3 is low, and the machine learning of the machine learning model of the vehicle 2 is performed in the vehicle 2 when the processing load in the server 3 is high. As a result, the server 3 having the highest processing speed performs machine learning of the machine learning model as much as possible, and the processing load of the server 3 can be suppressed from excessively increasing even when there is a request for machine learning from a large number of vehicles to the server 3.

< second embodiment >

Next, the machine learning system 1 according to the second embodiment and the machine learning method performed in the machine learning system 1 will be described with reference to fig. 9 and 10. The configuration and processing of the machine learning system 1 according to the second embodiment are basically the same as those of the machine learning system 1 according to the first embodiment. Hereinafter, description will be given mainly on differences from the machine learning system 1 of the first embodiment.

In the machine learning system 1 according to the first embodiment, the reference processing load used when determining the subject of machine learning of the machine learning model in the server 3 and the vehicle 2 is set to a constant value or a value that varies depending on the type of the machine learning model. In contrast, in the present embodiment, the reference processing load is set in consideration of the time required until the value of the learned model parameter is obtained in the vehicle 2 when the machine learning is performed in the server 3 (hereinafter, also referred to as "server processing required time") and the time required until the value of the learned model parameter is obtained in the vehicle 2 when the machine learning is performed in the vehicle 2 (hereinafter, also referred to as "vehicle processing required time").

More specifically, in the present embodiment, the reference processing load is set such that: if the server processing required time is longer than the vehicle processing required time, the server 3 needs to perform processing less, and therefore the vehicle 2 performs machine learning, and if the server processing required time is equal to or less than the vehicle processing required time, the server 3 or the vehicle 2 performs machine learning. A specific method of setting the reference processing load will be described below.

Fig. 9 is a functional block diagram of the processor 33 of the server 3 according to the present embodiment. As shown in fig. 9, in the present embodiment, the processor 33 includes a reference processing amount calculation unit 336 for calculating a reference processing amount in addition to the functional blocks of the processor 33 of the first embodiment.

Fig. 10 is an operation sequence diagram similar to fig. 7 of the learning process in the case where the server 3 performs the machine learning of the machine learning model according to the present embodiment. As shown in fig. 10, in the present embodiment, when the server-side receiving unit 335 receives the request signal via the external communication module 31, the reference processing amount calculating unit 336 calculates the reference processing amount.

The reference processing amount calculation unit 336 calculates the expected vehicle learning time, which is assumed to be taken when the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed in the vehicle side learning unit 145, based on the training data set generated by the data set generation unit 143 when calculating the reference processing amount. The expected vehicle learning time is calculated based on, for example, the calculation capability of the processor 14 of the vehicle 2, the processing capability based on the capacity of the semiconductor memory, the size of the training data set, and the structure of the machine learning model. The expected vehicle learning time is calculated so as to be shorter as the processing capability of the vehicle 2 is higher, and is calculated so as to be longer as the size of the training data set is larger and the structure of the machine learning model is more complicated.

In addition, the reference processing amount calculation unit 336 calculates an estimated communication time required for transmission and reception between the vehicle 2 and the server 3 of the values of the training data set and the model parameters when calculating the reference processing amount. The estimated communication time is a time required for the server 3 to perform machine learning. The expected communication time is calculated based on, for example, the size of the training data set, the number of model parameters of the machine learning model, and the communication strength of wireless communication between the vehicle 2 and the server 3. The expected communication time is calculated so as to be longer as the size of the training data set is larger and the number of model parameters is larger, and is calculated so as to be shorter as the communication intensity of the wireless communication is higher. The communication strength of the wireless communication may include not only the current communication strength but also an expected communication strength in the future. The future estimated communication strength is estimated from, for example, a future planned travel route of the vehicle 2. Therefore, for example, when the vehicle 2 is scheduled to travel on a mountain road with low communication intensity, the future expected communication intensity is set to a low value.

Then, the reference processing amount calculation unit 336 calculates a difference time obtained by subtracting the estimated communication time from the estimated vehicle learning time in the vehicle 2. If the time taken for the machine learning in the server 3 is longer than the difference time thus calculated, it means that the time required for the server processing is longer than the time required for the vehicle processing. On the other hand, if the time taken for machine learning in the server 3 is equal to or less than the difference time calculated in this way, it means that the time required for server processing is equal to or less than the time required for vehicle processing.

On the other hand, the arithmetic processing speed in the server 3 varies depending on the processing load of the server 3. When the processing load of the server 3 is high, the arithmetic processing speed in the server 3 is slow, and thus the time required for machine learning becomes long. Conversely, when the processing load of the server 3 is low, the arithmetic processing speed in the server 3 is high, and thus the time required for machine learning becomes short.

In the present embodiment, the reference processing amount calculation unit 336 sets, as the reference processing load, a load that requires the difference time for the server 3 to perform machine learning of the machine learning model (hereinafter referred to as "difference time equivalent load"). As a result, since the server 3 performs machine learning when the current processing load is equal to or less than the reference processing load, the server 3 performs machine learning only when the server processing required time is equal to or less than the vehicle processing required time.

In the present embodiment, the reference processing load is set as the difference time equivalent load. However, the reference processing load may be set to a load lower than the differential time equivalent load. Even in this case, the server 3 can perform machine learning only when the server processing required time is equal to or shorter than the vehicle processing required time. The reference processing load may be, for example, a load that is lower than the latency equivalent load and that changes according to the type of the machine learning model.

< third embodiment >

Next, a machine learning system 1 according to a third embodiment and a machine learning method performed in the machine learning system 1 will be described with reference to fig. 11. The configuration and processing of the machine learning system 1 according to the third embodiment are basically the same as those of the machine learning system 1 according to the first and second embodiments. Hereinafter, description will be given mainly on differences from the machine learning system 1 of the first and second embodiments.

In the machine learning system 1 according to the first and second embodiments described above, all machine learning processes are performed in either one of the vehicle 2 and the server 3. In contrast, in the present embodiment, the machine learning process of the machine learning model is performed in a distributed manner in the vehicle 2 and the server 3 according to the processing load of the server 3.

Fig. 11 is an operation sequence diagram similar to fig. 7 of the learning process according to the present embodiment. The same processes as those in fig. 7 are denoted by the same step numbers, and the description of these processes is omitted.

In the present embodiment, as shown in fig. 11, when the server-side receiving unit 335 receives the request signal, the processing amount determining unit 332 determines the processing amount of machine learning to be performed in each of the server 3 and the vehicle 2 based on the current processing load of the server 3 detected by the processing load detecting unit 331 (step S35). In the present embodiment, the higher the current processing load of the server 3, the smaller the amount of processing for machine learning in the server 3 and the larger the amount of processing for machine learning in the vehicle 2. The processing amount of machine learning in the server 3 and the vehicle 2 may be changed stepwise or continuously according to the processing load. Therefore, if the above description is summarized, in all the embodiments including the first embodiment and the second embodiment, when the current processing load of the server 3 is relatively high, the amount of processing of machine learning in the server 3 is reduced as compared with when the current processing load is relatively low.

When the processing amount is determined by the processing amount determination unit 332, the server-side transmission unit 334 transmits a notification of the processing amount of each of the vehicle 2 and the server 3 to the vehicle 2 via the external communication module 31 (step S36). When the vehicle-side receiving unit 148 receives the notification, the vehicle-side transmitting unit 147 transmits information necessary for performing machine learning of the machine learning model of the vehicle 2 via the vehicle exterior communication module 21 (step S17).

When the server-side receiving unit 335 receives information necessary for performing machine learning via the external communication module 31, the server-side learning unit 333 performs machine learning on the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model based on the processing amount in the server 3 determined in step S35 (step S37). The server-side learning unit 333 updates the values of the model parameters by a known method such as the error back propagation method described above using the training data set with the current values of the model parameters transmitted from the vehicle 2 as initial values. In this case, the server-side learning unit 333 ends the machine learning process before the machine learning of the machine learning model is completed, as long as the processing amount in the server 3 determined in step S35 is not the entire processing amount of the machine learning.

When the learning of the machine learning model by the server-side learning unit 333 is completed, the server-side transmission unit 334 transmits the values of the model parameters during learning, which are obtained by the machine learning by the server-side learning unit 333, to the vehicle 2 via the external communication module 31 (step S38).

When the vehicle-side receiving unit 148 receives the value of the model parameter during learning, the vehicle-side learning unit 145 machine-learns the value of the model parameter of the machine learning model based on the processing amount in the vehicle 2 determined in step S35 using the training data set with the value of the model parameter during learning transmitted from the server 3 as an initial value (step S39). Until the learning is completed, the machine learning in the vehicle-side learning unit 145 generates a learned machine learning model.

In the above embodiment, the processing amount determination unit 332 determines the processing amount of the machine learning performed in each of the server 3 and the vehicle 2. However, the processing amount determination unit 332 may determine a ratio (processing ratio) of the processing amount performed by the server 3 to the processing amount performed by the vehicle 2. In the above embodiment, first, the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed halfway in the server 3, and then the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed to completion in the vehicle 2. However, the machine learning of the machine learning model may be performed in the vehicle 2 to the middle first, and then the machine learning of the machine learning model may be performed in the server 3 to the completion.
